envelope.description: Separate per-session execution and action ownership

body.title: Separate per-session execution and action ownership
body.summary: Move queued run, follow state, pending decisions and diff ownership into session runtimes. Wire the targeted actions and progress snapshots to the current view without ending the previous runtime.
acceptanceChecks: Switch A → B → A without a new provider event and restore A’s phase and time. Late A terminal or transcript output cannot affect B.
Stop, approval, choice and edit decisions validate session, turn, view generation and relevant request/path. An ended turn’s pending continuation remains actionable only for its original request.
Reject automated rollback when overlapping changes invalidate proof of exclusive ownership.
Delayed Stop and decisions with repeated request IDs cannot act on another session. A valid pending continuation remains actionable after its originating provider turn ended.
